configOverrideMechanism.reason: Most RenderEvent listeners are registered inside onEnable(), not the constructor. The config-determined enabled set therefore decides which subscribers exist at all on the first frame, and hence the real dispatch order.
configOverrideMechanism.detail: The runtime config is not in this repository. defaultEnabled in the inventory is the CONSTRUCTOR value only; whether it was overwritten must be read from the game machine's config or observed via the SOLSTICE_RENDER_DIAG log. It is never inferred here.
